name: Vorn's Agent
title: Debt Collector of the Iron Ledger

abilities.name: Legalistic Bind
abilities.trigger: A creature within 30 ft. damages the debt collector or an ally the debt collector is protecting, or attempts to seize an item the debt collector claims.
abilities.description: The target must succeed at a DC 19 Will save or be paralyzed for 1 round as infernal chains of contract law wrap around them. On a critical failure, the target is also stunned 1. A creature that succeeds is temporarily immune for 24 hours.

abilities.name: Infernal Warrant
abilities.description: The debt collector presents a writ. One target within 30 ft. must succeed at a DC 19 Will save or be dominated (as dominate, level 3) for 1 minute. The command is always 'Surrender the asset.'

abilities.name: Contractual Evasion
abilities.trigger: The debt collector would take damage from a spell or ability.
abilities.description: The debt collector attempts a Deception check against the effect's DC. On a success, they take half damage; on a critical success, no damage and the effect's originator takes 1d6 mental damage as the contract rebounds.

abilities.name: Seize Asset
abilities.requirements: The debt collector has an opponent grabbed or restrained.
abilities.description: The debt collector attempts to Disarm the target of a specific item (the 'asset'). On a success, the item teleports to the debt collector's hand. This is a teleportation effect.
